from_system: NHBE / BEAS2B / COPD bronchial epithelial cells (KI-696 EC50 12-36 nM [CH])

what_does_not: potency in cells (nanomolar in epithelium; 40 uM was needed for a protective effect in LUHMES with the enantiomer 2); permeability of an acid in neurons; NRF2 level at baseline
bridge_measure_needed: target presence (KEAP1, NRF2 protein) and a dose-response of nuclear NRF2 plus 2 target genes in the neural cell itself

from_system: primary rat microglia and BV2 (Wu: C7 0.5-1 uM, loss arms verified)
what_transfers: on-target dependence is demonstrable for this compound when the loss is verified (A40-A44)
what_does_not: dependence in microglia does not show dependence in a neuron or astrocyte; endpoint was radiation-induced death
bridge_measure_needed: the same four-arm design in neurons and astrocytes separately

what_transfers: nuclear NRF2 rise at 4 h occurs in a human neuron-like cell; NQO1 mRNA rise without annonacin
what_does_not: protection with no target-gene induction under annonacin; knockdown inadequate so dependence is open; cell line, not primary
bridge_measure_needed: knockdown shown adequate at protein and target-gene level at the endpoint time; the protection endpoint and the target genes read at the same time point

from_system: astrocyte-to-neuron (Kraft: neuronal gene change dependent on astrocytic Nrf2)
what_transfers: a compartment structure is possible: activating or removing NRF2 in astrocytes changes neurons
what_does_not: neuron-only versus astrocyte-only arms for a non-covalent binder are not in any source reached
bridge_measure_needed: cell-type-restricted loss (conditional knockout or co-culture with one genotype)

what_transfers: protection from an externally imposed oxidant or mitochondrial stress with NRF2 involvement
what_does_not: WWOX loss is not an imposed stress; none of the sources has a WWOX-deficient cell; the held WWOX record is transcript-level only (S0/S1)
bridge_measure_needed: an NRF2 protein and nuclear-localisation measure in a WWOX-deficient neural cell before any arm (premise X0)

what_transfers: one source has a functional readout (locomotor score, rat radiation myelopathy, no NRF2-loss arm in vivo)
what_does_not: viability protection in culture is not recovery of network or behavioural function
bridge_measure_needed: a function readout in the neural system with the loss arm

what_transfers: NRF2-dependent (Linker, in vivo) and NRF2-independent (Parodi HCAR2, 30587509 protein modification) routes coexist for fumarates
what_does_not: an effect that survives NRF2 loss for a fumarate cannot be assigned to a binder; a binder is not exposed to those routes
bridge_measure_needed: run both compound classes with the same loss arm in the same cell and compare equal on-target response (nuclear NRF2, 2 genes), not equal concentration

what_transfers: target-gene induction is a usable proxy when the loss arm removes it
what_does_not: NQO1 rises without NRF2 pathway activation (progesterone, Tran); HMOX1 moved through HCAR2 in microglia (Parodi); NQO1 mRNA collapsed under annonacin while protection stayed (Costa)
bridge_measure_needed: at least two readout classes beside NQO1 (nuclear NRF2 protein; a second gene; viability)
